# Prepsto: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-06 · code 57da39c38d3e · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** A feedback panel you drop on any site with one link. Collect, triage and turn customer feedback into user stories, and let people track what happens to their idea.
**Live:** https://prepsto.com · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/prepsto · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `.claude/skills/prepsto/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py prepsto` refreshes this map.

- **entries**: board→boards, kind:str, message:str, rating:num, email:str, name:str, page_url:str, context:obj, status:str, priority:str, tags:obj, starred:bool, story→stories, ai:obj, created:dt, updated:dt, is_demo:bool, assignee→users, track:str, track_seen:dt, reply_waiting:bool · used in Admin, ApiRoutes, Boards, DemoData, Inbox, Samples, Stories, Team, Tracking
- **feedback**: user→users, name:str, email:str, kind:str, message:str, context:obj, status:str, note:str, created:dt · used in Feedback
- **members**: board→boards, user→users, email:str, role:str, status:str, token:str, invited_by→users, created:dt, joined:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Boards, DemoData, Team
- **notifications**: user→users, actor→users, kind:str, board→boards, entry→entries, story→stories, text:str, read:bool, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Boards, Inbox, Stories, Team
- **stories**: board→boards, owner→users, title:str, persona:str, goal:str, benefit:str, acceptance:obj, notes:str, priority:str, status:str, points:num, source:str, created:dt, updated:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Admin, Boards, Inbox, Samples, Stories
- **updates**: entry→entries, board→boards, kind:str, value:str, text:str, author→users, created:dt, is_demo:bool · used in Tracking
- **users**: email:str, enabled:bool, last_login:dt, password_hash:str, n_password_failures:num, confirmed_email:bool, signed_up:dt, display_name:str, is_admin:bool, is_demo:bool, last_seen:dt, legal_version:str, legal_accepted_at:dt, legal_source:str, starter_done:bool · used in Admin, DemoData, Inbox, Team

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
